$comment: Design choice, not fact: every camera value (center, zoom, pitch, bearing, zoomShift) and every layer was picked to prove the sentence the stop sits by (map tours batch 3, 22 Oct 2026). Facts: text is a sentence of the guide, or a tightened form of one; cite is from the cite list of the guide chapter or fly it comes from. Points are the IGN place names of data/story/names-somontano.geojson or the river's own line.

facts.label: Somontano de Barbastro
facts.text: The Somontano de Barbastro lies to the east.

facts.label: River Vero
facts.text: A string of rivers crosses the area, among them the Alcanadre, the Vero and the Cinca.

facts.label: Wetter north
facts.text: It turns wetter and colder to the north, and drier and warmer to the south and east.

facts.label: Somontano
facts.text: The climate can be called Mediterranean continental.

facts.label: Sierra de Guara
facts.text: On the northern edge rise sierras such as Guara, Balcés and Salinas.

facts.label: Barbastro
facts.text: Near Barbastro a narrow band, also running roughly east to west, brings gypsum to the surface.
